name: ESADE
summary: Private business and law school in Barcelona; four bachelor's and two double degrees taught in English on its Sant Cugat campus.

ib.text: Predicted 32/42 (core excluded) can be considered; admitted students average 36/42. IB maths required for business degrees. Esade test or SAT/ACT; UNEDasiss credential to enrol.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Business Administration – BBA
programmes.about: A four-year business degree with compulsory internships and an optional exchange or dual programme in China or Canada; the English section is taught 100% in English.
programmes.overview: The degree builds a general management foundation and adds marketing, finance, operations and human resources, so you can weigh each decision across the whole company; AI tools and data analytics are woven into the subjects. You learn by solving real cases, simulating the creation and running of companies, and taking part in business games and capstone projects, taught partly by executives from companies. A semester abroad and a semester-long internship in the fourth year are compulsory, and you can choose a minor such as data analytics, finance, consulting, entrepreneurship, marketing, or global leadership and diversity. A dual programme with partners in China or Canada is also offered.
programmes.ib: Apply to the English section (100% English); a bilingual section also runs. Maths AA SL 5 / HL 4, or AI HL 4 / SL 6.

needs.note: AA SL 5 or AA HL 4; AI HL 4; AI SL needs 6.

programmes.selectionNote: Holistic, rolling admission: IB record and predicted grades, the Esade test (or SAT/ACT) and essays, judged by committees every two weeks.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Business and Artificial Intelligence
programmes.credential: Bachelor in Business and Artificial Intelligence
programmes.about: Business fundamentals combined with rigorous technical training in machine learning, deep learning, generative AI and software for business; taught 100% in English.
programmes.overview: Business fundamentals are joined to a technical core in advanced mathematics, machine learning, deep learning, computational modelling, generative AI, natural language processing, computer vision, software development for business and cloud solutions, along with ethics, legal frameworks and human-centred AI. You work on hackathons, datathons and boot camps, and with classmates you simulate creating and running companies using AI strategies. An internship is compulsory, in Spain or abroad, with a solidarity placement in developing countries as an option, and a semester exchange comes in the fourth year. The result is a hybrid profile linking business units and technical teams.
programmes.ib: Maths AA SL 6, or AA HL or AI HL at 5.

needs.note: AA SL 6, or AA HL or AI HL at 5; AI SL is not listed.

programmes.selectionNote: Holistic, rolling admission: IB record and predicted grades, the Esade test (or SAT/ACT) and essays, judged by committees every two weeks.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Global Governance, Economics & Legal Order
programmes.about: International relations, economics and law taught entirely in English, with internships at international organisations and a Global Economics or Global Politics track.
programmes.overview: The course combines economics, international relations, international law and public policy, covering legal systems, human rights, cybersecurity, macroeconomics, geopolitics and international institutions. In the second year you choose a track, either economics and finance or international relations and public policy. Learning is hands-on, through practical cases, international moot courts, model United Nations sessions and capstone modules based on a European Investment Bank project, with a compulsory semester abroad. Internships in the third and fourth years can be at international organisations such as the World Bank or UNESCO, and language electives include Spanish, French, German, Arabic and Mandarin.
programmes.ib: Maths studied at school is required only for the Global Economics track, not for Global Politics.
programmes.selectionNote: Holistic, rolling admission: IB record and predicted grades, the Esade test (or SAT/ACT) and essays, judged by committees every two weeks.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Transformational Leadership and Social Impact
programmes.about: Business and humanities for social impact, taught entirely in English, with a six-week class stay in Berlin in the second year.
programmes.overview: Business, humanities and technology are taught together, with business tools for sustainability and social impact (entrepreneurship, marketing, finance, operations, strategy, design thinking), humanities such as philosophy, anthropology, sociology and psychology, and AI and big data applied to human problems. Much of the work happens in cross-cutting collaborative projects, in a dedicated classroom, a Fab Lab and company settings, with a compulsory internship and an optional solidarity internship. Cohorts are small, at around fifty students, and international experiences in Europe and Asia are part of the course. Graduates aim to become impact entrepreneurs or managers working for social impact.
programmes.ib: Maths AA SL 5 / HL 4, or AI HL 4 / SL 6.

needs.note: AA SL 5 or AA HL 4; AI HL 4; AI SL needs 6.

programmes.selectionNote: Holistic, rolling admission: IB record and predicted grades, the Esade test (or SAT/ACT) and essays, judged by committees every two weeks.

programmes.name: Double Degree Bachelor of Business Administration & Business and Artificial Intelligence
programmes.credential: BBA + Bachelor in Business and AI
programmes.about: Two official degrees in five years, taught entirely in English: a full business education plus advanced AI, for consulting, investment banking or tech roles.
programmes.overview: Two degrees run side by side: a full business administration programme and a technical programme in business and artificial intelligence, giving a base in management plus a STEM foundation in machine learning and AI. Learning by doing includes hackathons, datathons and boot camps, tech dialogues with experts from industry and academia, and situated projects in which you apply AI in a real context and weigh its social and environmental effects. An internship is compulsory, with a solidarity option abroad. Graduates move into areas such as finance, marketing, operations, logistics or human resources, bridging business and technology teams.
programmes.ib: Maths AA SL 6, or AA HL or AI HL at 5.

needs.note: AA SL 6, or AA HL or AI HL at 5; AI SL is not listed.

programmes.name: Double Degree in Business Administration + Bachelor in Global Governance, Economics & Legal Order
programmes.about: Two official degrees in five years, taught 100% in English: business administration with international relations, economics and law, and consulting projects.
programmes.overview: Management is studied together with geopolitics, international law, economics and public policy from the first year, and you finish with a business degree plus a track in economics and finance or in international relations and public policy. In the second and third years, teams carry out strategic consulting projects for partner companies, and learning also comes from moot courts, model United Nations sessions, business simulations and an annual capstone with the European Investment Bank. Exchanges, optional study experiences abroad and a study tour make it the most international of the dual programmes, and internships are compulsory. Graduates can lead in firms and institutions that deal with global politics and economics.

notes: Admission can be revoked if your final IB score is more than 3 points below the minimum predicted grade Esade admitted you on.
Applications remain open only while places are available, through June 2027 at the latest; committees meet every two weeks, so apply early. Esade has not published an exact closing day.
The application fee is €150, non-refundable; Law and the Spanish-English double degrees are not taught fully in English.
